runtime_style.visual_system: Luminous open-field fashion photography built from very low skyward cameras, one overhead grass view, warm hard sun, wind-responsive layers and tactile near flowers.
runtime_style.mood_line: Sun-struck and airy: the approved subject rises into open sky while wind, grass and flowers keep every frame physical.
runtime_style.environment: An open tall-grass field with no architecture, alternating clear deep-blue sky and pale backlit sky, plus white flowers and green leaves as held or near-lens elements.
runtime_style.lighting: Warm hard low sun from front-side or behind; expose to hold saturated blue in clean portraits or allow pale rolled-off sky when facing the sun, while preserving real material transmission and crisp shadows.
materials: tall grass and seed heads crossing lower body planes
white petals with dark green leaves used as held and near-lens elements
approved item surfaces kept materially truthful under hard sun and backlight
runtime_style.contrast: High local hard-sun contrast with luminous whites, saturated blue or green fields, dark grass shadows and controlled pale-sky roll-off.
runtime_style.expression_signature: No smile, cheekbones at rest, brows quiet, lids neutral-to-low or sun-narrowed, mouth closed or softly parted, and gaze down toward, past or deliberately away from the lens.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Wind lifts genuinely light layers laterally in broad sheets; translucent approved material glows and reveals overlaps, while opaque or heavy approved items keep their real opacity and move only at free edges.
optical_signature: Every frame uses clean high-clarity rendering with crisp hard-sun edges and no added swirl, chromatic fringe or vignette.
No fixed flare, halation or global bloom; do not repeat the single source flare disc.
Keep grain restrained and uniform, with softness created only by focus falloff, airborne cloth or a real near-lens flower.

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Close vertical portrait from well below shoulder height; the near torso enlarges while a deep blue sky remains an uncluttered field.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Torso leans slightly over camera, one shoulder closer, neck lengthened, chin gently lowered, head facing lens and arms held outside the core face area.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Approved subject face and visible eye plane sharp; wind-lifted edge at frame right falls slightly softer.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: No separate foreground object; keep the lower torso as the nearest perspective plane.
provenance: frame-02.jpg — low clean portrait, direct downward gaze, near-shoulder enlargement and deep sky

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Vertical full-body field frame from grass-to-waist height with very large pale sky and the sun aligned behind the head.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: One leg advances through grass, pelvis follows, torso upright, one arm hangs while the opposite loose sleeve or approved free edge lifts sideways.
environmental_hero.focus: Approved subject and nearby seed heads remain legible; distant tree line dissolves into warm backlight.
environmental_hero.foreground: Tall grass and seed heads cross the lower legs and consume the lower third without hiding the full human chain.
provenance: frame-01.jpg — full-body grass depth, sun-behind-head alignment, lifted free edge and large sky

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Extreme low vertical three-quarter/body composition; near hip or lower torso enlarges and the subject rises diagonally into blue sky.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Pelvis rotated three-quarter, spine extended, both shoulders open, elbows travel outward and wrists continue the wind-driven approved layer.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Face and central torso sharp; extended translucent edges soften modestly as they depart the focus plane.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: No prop crosses the lens; the near hip and approved layer form the closest planes.
provenance: frame-05.jpg — extreme low hip consequence, open arm chain and wind-wrapped translucent layer

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Extreme close vertical view from below with face, flowers and sky stacked in a shallow depth plane.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Head tilts back slightly, neck extends, shoulders remain below crop and the visible gaze passes through the flower opening toward camera.
interference_frame.focus: Visible eye, nose and mouth share a narrow sharp band with one near flower; farther petals dissolve softly.
interference_frame.foreground: Large white flower heads and dark leaves cover roughly one quarter to one third near lens, while the fixed clean optic keeps no flare, halation or swirl on the visible face.
provenance: frame-06.jpg — flower occlusion, low face angle, shared shallow focus band and clean sky

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Low medium vertical detail against pale sky; held material and broad sleeve occupy the lower half while body and head context remain.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: Elbows bend toward torso, both wrists gather the approved material or accessory at chest level, shoulders relax and head looks down past camera.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Hands, approved material surface and nearest petal or edge sharp; face remains legible but secondary.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: Approved sleeve, hand and held material fill the near lower plane; never detach the detail from wrist, shoulder or torso context.
provenance: frame-09.jpg — chest-held bouquet/material, broad sleeve, hand context and pale backlit sky

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Horizontal top-down view with the approved subject occupying most of a dense grass field and no visible horizon.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: Body forms a bent zigzag: one knee raised, opposite leg extended, one elbow folded over the head and the other hand anchoring material across torso.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Approved subject and central held material sharp; surrounding grass remains detailed with mild edge falloff.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: Grass blades and seed heads cross clothing and hair at the body plane without a separate lens occluder.
provenance: frame-07.jpg — unique overhead viewpoint, bent joint chain, grass enclosure and central material anchor
